schema.name: nx_sim_loads
schema.description: Page loads in the active SIM and reacquire simulation_load references after reopen. offset >=0; limit 1..100. Compact rows include type, target-set count, stored provenance and energy-accounting label. Optional properties expose actual native values/units and unsupported reads. Optional targets return up to 100 members per set with counts/truncation flags; direct SIM body/face targets have typed references, other kinds are explicit unsupported targets. Does not sum mixed loads or infer total applied scenario power. Constraints and simulation objects are separate collections. Read-only; does not save, activate or solve.

outputSchema.description: Structured success/error envelope with additive metadata. Tool-specific payload remains extensible.
outputSchema.title: nx_sim_loads result
